chuck.airborne.3.heard: He punted him! He punted him!

chuck.airborne.4.heard: Up, up, and out of here.

chuck.chase.1.heard: He's on the run. Go get him.

chuck.chase.2.heard: Chase him down. Don't let him escape.

chuck.chase.4.heard: Run baby, run. He's right behind you.

chuck.count.1.heard: The count's on. Get up. Get up.

chuck.decision.1.heard: Going to the judges. It's in their hands now.

chuck.decision.2.heard: Both still standing. Judges, your call.

chuck.decision.3.heard: Close one, Dale. Could go either way.

chuck.decision.4.heard: That's a full 60 minutes of football. Er, three. Three minutes.

chuck.desk.1.heard: Dale, I have been waiting all week for this.

chuck.desk.2.heard: Chuck Kowalski here, and Dale, I am fired up.

chuck.desk.3.heard: These robots came to play tonight, Dale. I can feel it.

chuck.desk.4.heard: Big night, Dale. Big night. I barely slept.

chuck.desk.5.heard: I watch film on every one of these robots. Twice.

chuck.drivedown.1.heard: He's running in circles. Lost a drive.

chuck.drivedown.2.heard: One side's dead. He can't go straight.

chuck.drivedown.3.heard: He's limping. Only one side pushing.

chuck.drivedown.4.heard: Spinning in place. That's a bad ankle.

chuck.fire.1.heard: It's on fire! It's on fire!

chuck.flip.2.heard: Turned him over like a fumble.

chuck.flip.4.heard: He's on his back. Get up.

chuck.hit.3.heard: That's a clean shot right there.

chuck.hit.5.heard: Somebody get that robot a helmet.

chuck.huge.2.heard: That is a Hall of Fame hit, Dale.

chuck.huge.3.heard: Call the trainer. Call the trainer.

chuck.huge.4.heard: I felt that one in my knees.

chuck.huge.5.heard: That's a sack. That is a sack.

chuck.idle.1.heard: You know Dale, a robot is a lot like a lineman. Low center of gravity wins.

chuck.idle.2.heard: These builders practice all year. That's dedication. That's heart.

chuck.idle.3.heard: In my playing days, I would have loved a hammer like that pulverizer.

chuck.idle.4.heard: Driving a robot is all about vision. You got to read the field.

chuck.idle.5.heard: I talked to the teams in the pits. These folks are tough, Dale.

chuck.idle.6.heard: Defense wins championships. Armor is defense. It's that simple.

chuck.idle.7.heard: I've been hit hard, Dale. Real hard. Nothing like these robots, though.

chuck.idle.8.heard: You got to respect the hustle. Every robot out here earned its spot.

chuck.intro.1.heard: This is a great matchup, Dale. Strength on strength.

chuck.intro.2.heard: Both teams look ready. I can feel it.

chuck.intro.3.heard: Gotta win the battle in the trenches here.

chuck.intro.4.heard: Watch the first 10 seconds, that sets the tone.

chuck.intro.5.heard: Game face is on. Let's see what they got.

chuck.panel.4.heard: Panels off. Go after that side.

chuck.pin.1.heard: He's got him pinned. Drive, drive.

chuck.pin.2.heard: He's carrying him like a fullback.

chuck.pin.3.heard: Pinned! Push him to the hazards!

chuck.ramrod.2.heard: The floor came up and got him.

chuck.ramrod.3.heard: Ooh, spikes from below. Cheap shot.

chuck.righted.1.heard: He's back up. What a comeback.

chuck.righted.2.heard: Back on his feet. Get in there.

chuck.righted.3.heard: He shook it off. Tough kid.

chuck.righted.4.heard: Righted! The drive is still alive!

chuck.rookie.1.heard: Love this rookie team. Hungry, raw talent.

chuck.rookie.2.heard: First time in the box. Welcome to the big leagues.

chuck.rookie.3.heard: The rookie's got heart, Dale. You can't coach heart.

chuck.rookie.4.heard: Rookie season. I remember mine. I threw four interceptions.

chuck.rookie.5.heard: Give this rookie a chance. They might surprise you.

chuck.saw.2.heard: The Killsaws are in the game.

chuck.saw.3.heard: Sparks everywhere. That's got to hurt.

chuck.saw.4.heard: He drove right over the saws.

chuck.smoke.4.heard: Smoke coming out. He's hurt, Dale.

chuck.spikes.1.heard: Into the spikes! That's a body slam!

chuck.spikes.2.heard: He drove him right into the spikes.

chuck.spikes.3.heard: Rammed into the spike wall. Ugh.

chuck.spikes.4.heard: Up against the spikes. Bad spot.

chuck.spinup.1.heard: Listen to that weapon wind up.

chuck.spinup.2.heard: Spinner's up to speed. Look out!

chuck.spinup.4.heard: Hear that? That is pure power.

chuck.start.3.heard: And they come off the line hard.

chuck.timelow.2.heard: 30 left. Leave it all on the field.

chuck.timelow.4.heard: Clock's running down. Go, go, go.

chuck.upset.1.heard: Upset! We've got an upset brewing!

chuck.upset.3.heard: Nobody gave him a chance. Look at him now.

chuck.upset.4.heard: This is a Cinderella story, Dale.

chuck.wall.1.heard: Into the boards! What a check!

chuck.wall.3.heard: Pinned on the sideline. Good effort.

chuck.wall.4.heard: He ran him right out of bounds.

chuck.weapondown.1.heard: The weapon's dead. No offense left.

chuck.weapondown.2.heard: Weapons down. Gotta play defense now.

chuck.weapondown.3.heard: Lost the weapon. No passing game.

chuck.weapondown.4.heard: That weapon is done for the day.

chuck.wheel.2.heard: He lost a wheel. That's an injury.

chuck.wheel.3.heard: Wheels gone. That's a blown knee.

dale.airborne.1.heard: And it's flying. Robots can fly now.

dale.bumper.2.heard: Don't go anywhere. Bot Box will be right back.

dale.bumper.3.heard: Stick around. More robot violence after this.

dale.bumper.4.heard: We'll be right back after a word from people with money.

dale.chase.1.heard: And the chase is on. Run, robot, run!

dale.chase.2.heard: One's running, one's chasing. It's a cartoon.

dale.chase.3.heard: This is a chase scene now.

dale.chase.4.heard: Look at it run. Smart, honestly.

dale.count.3.heard: It's not moving. Come on, little guy.

dale.decision.1.heard: And we're going to the judges. Fun.

dale.decision.2.heard: Nobody's dead, so the judges decide.

dale.decision.3.heard: Time for the judges. Everybody looked nervous.

dale.decision.4.heard: It's up to the judges. I'd bribe them, but they're honest.

dale.desk.1.heard: Welcome to Bot Box. I'm Dale Pruitt. And yes, this is my real job.

dale.desk.2.heard: Good evening. I'm Dale Pruitt. Tonight, robots fight and I make jokes about it.

dale.desk.3.heard: Welcome back to the box with me as always the cannon himself, Chuck Kowalski.

dale.desk.4.heard: Hi, I'm Dale. My mom thinks I host a cooking show.

dale.desk.5.heard: Tonight's robots have saws, hammers, and flamethrowers. Well, no flamethrowers. Yet.

dale.drivedown.1.heard: It's driving in circles. We've all been there.

dale.drivedown.2.heard: Lost the drive side. Round and round we go.

dale.drivedown.3.heard: It drives like a broken shopping cart.

dale.drivedown.4.heard: Look at its spin. It's having a moment.

dale.fire.1.heard: And it's on fire. That's bad, right?

dale.fire.2.heard: Something's cooking and it's not dinner.

dale.flip.5.heard: That's one way to see the ceiling.

dale.hit.1.heard: Ooh, that one left a mark.

dale.hit.5.heard: That's going to need a bandage. A metal one.

dale.huge.3.heard: Holy cow! Did you see that?

dale.huge.4.heard: That is going in the highlight reel.

dale.huge.5.heard: Oh, come on. That's just rude.

dale.idle.1.heard: These builders spent a whole year on this and a lot of duct tape.

dale.idle.2.heard: Fun fact, most of these robots were built in a garage. Most of these builders still live there.

dale.idle.3.heard: I asked a builder how much his robot cost. He started crying.

dale.idle.4.heard: If you're just joining us, robots are hitting each other. That's the show.

dale.idle.5.heard: The box is bulletproof Lexan, which is good because I'm sitting right here.

dale.idle.6.heard: I tried to build a robot once. It's a lamp now.

dale.idle.7.heard: The judges are watching closely. Well, two of them. One's eating a pretzel.

dale.idle.8.heard: Somewhere a mom is watching this and saying, please be careful. That's my son's robot.

dale.intro.1.heard: Two robots, one box. Let's see who blinks.

dale.intro.2.heard: Look at these two. Somebody's going home in a bucket.

dale.intro.3.heard: The builders look nervous. The robots look fine.

dale.intro.4.heard: I like this matchup. I have no idea why.

dale.intro.5.heard: Here we go. Keep your hands inside the Lexan.

dale.panel.1.heard: There goes a piece. Anybody want that?

dale.panel.2.heard: Armors off. That's a souvenir now.

dale.panel.3.heard: And a panel goes flying. Duck.

dale.panel.5.heard: Lost some armor. Who needs it?

dale.pin.1.heard: And now it's a piggyback ride.

dale.pin.2.heard: That's not a hug. That's a hostage situation.

dale.pulverizer.1.heard: And the Pulverizer makes a house call.

dale.pulverizer.3.heard: That's the pulverizer. Nobody likes the pulverizer.

dale.ramrod.1.heard: Floor spikes. The floor is angry.

dale.ramrod.2.heard: and the Ramrods give it a poke.

dale.righted.1.heard: And it's back on its wheels. Look at that.

dale.righted.2.heard: It got up. Good for you, buddy.

dale.righted.4.heard: Back on its feet. Well, wheels.

dale.rookie.1.heard: And here's our rookie team. Bless their hearts.

dale.rookie.2.heard: The rookies built this in a garage. You can tell.

dale.rookie.3.heard: First time in the box. No pressure. Only everybody watching.

dale.rookie.4.heard: Rookies, everybody be nice for now.

dale.rookie.5.heard: I love a rookie. So much hope. So many loose bolts.

dale.saw.3.heard: Ooh, the saw's got a taste!

dale.smoke.1.heard: And now we have smoke. Love that.

dale.smoke.2.heard: I see smoke. Not a great sign.

dale.smoke.3.heard: It's smoking. It should really quit.

dale.smoke.4.heard: Smoke signals. It's asking for help.

dale.spikes.1.heard: Into the spikes. That's a no for me.

dale.spikes.2.heard: Pinned on the spike strip. Ouch.

dale.spinup.1.heard: Hear that? That's the sound of trouble.

dale.spinup.2.heard: And the spinner's winding up. Uh-oh.

dale.spinup.3.heard: That wine means somebody's going to cry.

dale.start.2.heard: Here we go. Try not to blink.

dale.start.3.heard: And they're moving. That's step one.

dale.start.5.heard: And the fight is on. Finally.

dale.timelow.2.heard: Half a minute to go. Make it count.

dale.upset.2.heard: Upset alert. I did not see this coming.

dale.upset.3.heard: Folks, this was not in the script.

dale.wall.1.heard: And into the wall. Walls win again.

dale.wall.3.heard: Boom. Say hi to the wall.

dale.wall.4.heard: Parked it right in the wall.

dale.weapondown.1.heard: And the weapon just quit. Relatable.

dale.weapondown.2.heard: Weapons down. Now it's a very angry box.

dale.weapondown.4.heard: No more weapon. Time for plan B.

dale.wheel.1.heard: And that's a wheel, a loose wheel.

dale.whiff.1.heard: And a swing and a miss.

dale.whiff.3.heard: That was a very aggressive nothing.

dale.whiff.4.heard: Swinging at the air, bold strategy.

jenna.champ.1.heard: You did it! You won the giant nut! How does it feel?

jenna.champ.2.heard: Bot Box champions! Oh my gosh! Say something!

jenna.champ.3.heard: Champions! Can you guys even lift that thing?

jenna.final.1.heard: This is it, the final! How are you feeling right now?

jenna.final.2.heard: One more fight for the giant nut! Are you nervous?

jenna.final.3.heard: It's the final guys! Any last words before you go in?

jenna.lose.1.heard: Tough loss. What happened out there?

jenna.lose.2.heard: Aww, I'm so sorry guys, what went wrong?

jenna.lose.3.heard: That was rough. Are you going to rebuild?

jenna.lose.4.heard: You fought hard out there. What's next for the team?

jenna.pits.1.heard: I'm down in the pits where the rookie team is scrambling to get this thing ready.

jenna.pits.2.heard: Hey Dale, I'm in the pits and there are tools everywhere. Like everywhere.

jenna.pits.3.heard: I'm here with our rookies. They've got duct tape, a drill, and about four minutes.

jenna.pits.4.heard: Down here in the pits, you can smell the solder. It is so exciting.

jenna.win.1.heard: I'm here with the winners. How does it feel?

jenna.win.2.heard: Oh my gosh, you guys did it! Tell me everything!

jenna.win.3.heard: What a fight! Was that the plan all along?

jenna.win.4.heard: Congratulations! Did you think you could win that one?
